test_title: PYST 25: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A. By conquest, rather than by economic contract

B. Other types of feudalism was the relation

C. The principal difference between Indian and

D. Between lord and vassal, established in this case
solution:
The correct answer is **'C, B, D, A'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
 
• The first **sentence** will be **sentence** **C** because this fragment follows the initial part and hints at the main difference present in other forms of feudalism.
 
• After it, **Sentence B** will be used because this fragment follows the initial part and hints at the main difference present in other forms of feudalism. 
 
• **Sentence D** will be the third sentence because this fragment adds specificity by highlighting the particular aspect that distinguishes the relationships in Indian feudalism from other types: the relationship between the lord and vassal.
 
• Finally, **Sentence A** will be used because this fragment concludes the sentence by explaining how this relationship between the lord and vassal was established in the case of Indian feudalism, emphasizing that it was established through conquest, unlike economic contracts seen in other feudal systems.

 
 
 

**Correct Order:__** *The principal difference between Indian and other types of feudalism was the relation between lord and vassal, established in this case by conquest, rather than by economic contract.*
